input.title: sessions: Improve GitHub context attachments
input.body:
[REDACTED-CLOSING-REF]
[REDACTED-CLOSING-REF]

Makes GitHub issue and pull request context attachments openable from the new-session composer, and recognizes pasted GitHub URLs in the corresponding picker. Also aligns attachment pill spacing and dismiss icons with the compact control treatment and documents the interaction in accessibility help.

Validation:
- `./scripts/test.sh --run src/vs/sessions/contrib/chat/test/browser/newChatInput.test.ts --grep "renders GitHub context pills"`
- `npm --prefix extensions/copilot run test:unit -- src/extension/chatSessions/vscode-node/test/copilotCloudSessionsProvider.spec.ts`
- `npm --prefix extensions/copilot run typecheck`
- `npm run hygiene`
- Component Explorer: `NewSessionAttachedContext` Dark/Light render without errors; Dark is visually stable.
